title: IPRAL-Lidar-Processing: calibration and backscatter retrieval for IPRAL 355 nm far-range signals
description: Research processing chain for the IPRAL 355 nm far-range lidar (SIRTA, Palaiseau): L0 to L1 calibration (calibration coefficient, residual background, polarization cross-talk, analog/photon-counting merging) and L1 to L2 particle backscatter retrieval (Klett-Fernald-Sasano inversion). The algorithms are described in the technical note 'Calibration Procedure and Backscatter Retrieval for IPRAL 355 nm Far-Range Signals' (Technical Note v1.0, LMD/IPSL). Developed to support the ATLID/EarthCARE zenith-to-nadir comparison study. This is a research processing chain, not the operational IPRAL/SIRTA processing.
